title: Dual-Edge Spatial-Jacobian Image Graph Framework for Interpretable DR Grading
excerpt: Introduces a dual-edge spatial-Jacobian image graph framework for interpretable diabetic retinopathy grading by combining vessel-lesion spatial edges with Jacobian-based lesion-biomarker edges.

title: RetiSEM: Generalising Causal Models for Fragmented Biomedical Data
excerpt: RetiSEM presents a causal modelling framework for fragmented biomedical data, designed to recover interpretable structure under incomplete, multimodal, and distributed evidence settings.
citation: Ullah, Inam and Razzak, Imran and Jameel, Shoaib. (2026). "RetiSEM: Generalising Causal Models for Fragmented Biomedical Data." Accepted at IJCAI 2026.

title: Integrated Oculomics and Lipidomics Reveal Microvascular Metabolic Signatures Associated with Cardiovascular Health
excerpt: Integrates retinal imaging with lipidomic profiles to uncover microvascular and metabolic signatures associated with cardiovascular health.

title: Retinal Lipidomics Associations as Candidate Biomarkers for Cardiovascular Health
venue: Proceedings of 2025 International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2025)
excerpt: Explores links between retinal microvascular traits and lipidomic profiles to identify candidate non-invasive biomarkers for cardiovascular risk.

title: The Eye as a Window to Systemic Health: A Survey of Retinal Imaging from Classical Techniques to Oculomics
venue: The Journal of Precision Medicine: Health and Disease
excerpt: A broad survey of retinal imaging and oculomics, mapping how ocular biomarkers can inform systemic, cardiovascular, and metabolic health.

title: Deciphering the Impact of Diversity in CNN-Based Ensembles on Overcoming Data Imbalance and Scarcity
excerpt: Shows how architectural and data-level diversity in CNN ensembles improves robustness under class imbalance and limited medical imaging data.

title: Data Diversity in Convolutional Neural Network Based Ensemble Model for Diabetic Retinopathy
excerpt: Examines how ensemble diversity can mitigate data scarcity in diabetic retinopathy modelling and improve generalisation in clinical imaging settings.
